0.original: Eylgar would like to impose upon the kindness of an adventurer.

1.original: Eylgar has asked you to verify the claims of a Lalafellin peddler, who swears that winged beasts attacked him on the road south of Bentbranch. Retrace his steps and search for any evidence to support his story.

2.original: After stumbling upon a large vulture egg, two northern vultures descend to defend their nest. Now that you have slain the beasts, seek out Lothaire at Galvanth's Spire and tell him what transpired.

3.original: Lothaire is shocked to learn of the nest hidden less than twenty yalms from his post. He implores you to keep its existence a secret, and vows that similar incidents will never happen again.

24.original: Search for signs of the winged beasts.

48.original: To accept this quest, you must abandon the current main scenario quest. Open the corresponding entry in the journal or duty list and select “Abandon.”

49.original: You're quite the compassionate adventurer, by the sound of it. Well far be it from me to look a gift chocobo in the mouth─I have need of a capable <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> like yourself.

50.original: We received a peddler at the gates the other day─an excitable Lalafell that was sweating and swearing that he had been attacked by large winged beasts. Yet other than hornets, I know of no flying creatures in this region.

51.original: If there's any truth to what he said, it might prove problematic for other travelers. Follow the road south and see if you can find any evidence to support his claim.

52.original: And, should you find something, kindly tell Lothaire to patrol his area sometime instead of just standing beneath the spire and staring at the godsdamned road. In those words.

53.original: ...A northern vulture? Two? And they were defending a <hex:021A020203>nest<hex:021A020103>!?

54.original: Well, I, uh...perhaps we could omit that last detail from any official reports. I would rather not give Eylgar any further cause to be cross.

55.original: Thank you for slaying the beasts. You may rest assured that I will not permit this to happen again.

56.original: You hear the beating of wings...
